description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the API endpoints related to retrieving module data in the V8 API version. It contains setup methods, positive and negative test cases for specific API calls, and data providers for different test scenarios.

classes.name: GetModuleCest
classes.description: A test class for API endpoint testing related to modules in the V8 API. Provides setup, positive and negative test cases, and data providers.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Sets up preconditions before each test, notably logging in via API.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Tests the successful retrieval of module data with valid endpoints and parameters.

methods.name: shouldNotWork
methods.description: Tests API endpoint error handling with invalid requests and parameters.

methods.name: shouldWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for successful API call scenarios.

methods.name: shouldNotWorkDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for invalid API call scenarios.
